The raw aliases are peak concentrations in brain tissue and are scientifically equivalent to brain Cmax; no denominator or binding-state distinction is present.

The raw endpoint is maximum concentration in brain tissue divided by plasma concentration. Only the numerator is explicitly Cmax, so the canonical label does not overstate the denominator as plasma Cmax.

Ordinary brain-tissue concentration aliases are globally reconciled to brain_concentration. Explicit route, genotype, and phenotype comparisons remain separate, and comparison wording is not promoted to a ratio without stated division.
